theme.description: High-contrast precision mixed with vibrant neon signals. Dark UI represents the 'system/engine' (performance, analytics), while light UI sections represent 'management/operations' (staff, inventory, floor plans).

headings.strategy: Tracking tight, high impact, assertive. Do not use generic sans for headings.

body.strategy: High legibility, clean geometric forms, loose line-height.

mono.strategy: Used for AI decisions, code snippets, timestamps, data tables, and badges.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 to p-16 internally for cards, py-24 to py-32 for sections. Ensure visual breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento Grid Protocol. Strict column structures (12-col for marketing grids, 3/4-col for dashboards). Asymmetry creates tension.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards must elevate slightly (-translate-y-1) and gain an ambient border glow matching their primary context color.
motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion for staggered fade-up on text and bento items.
motion_and_interaction.active_elements: data-testid mandatory for all buttons, inputs, tabs, and interactive elements. Format: kebab-case, role-based.

sections.layout: Sticky nav with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0b0b0f]/70. Centralized H1 'AI-Powered Operating System for Modern Hospitality'.
sections.visuals: Animated radial background gradient blending #8b5cf6, #0b0b0f, and #f58c14. Overlaid with a CSS-built mock dashboard (glassy panels, AI stat cards, floating charts).
sections.ctas: Book Demo (Primary Orange #f58c14) + Watch Product Tour (Purple outline).

sections.layout: 10-module Bento Grid ('Tetris' mode). Diverse col-spans to avoid boring equal squares.
sections.content: Cards for POS, Reservations, KDS, Loyalty Engine, Inventory & Purchasing, Staff Management, AI Command Center, Analytics Dashboard, Marketing Automation, Voice POS.
sections.visuals: bg-[#1c1c26] cards with 1px border. On hover: shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(139,92,246,0.15)].

sections.content: Headline: 'Meet Ash. Your Autonomous Restaurant Manager.'
sections.visuals: Live decision feed UI built with HTML/CSS. Stream of events: 'Ash -> Action -> Outcome -> Status'. Use JetBrains Mono for the logs. Accents in #8b5cf6.
Framer Motion audio waveform animation. Real-time transcription typing effect ('Ash, 86 the sea bass and comp table 4').

sections.layout: Split section: Text on left, UI mockup on right.
sections.visuals: Interactive floor plan UI built with CSS grid. Tables as geometric shapes turning colors based on AI prediction (e.g., Purple for VIP arriving, Orange for overdue).

sections.layout: Feature highlight with Pink (#ec4899) as the dominant accent.
sections.visuals: Points/tiers/redemption CSS mockups. Progress bars, VIP cards with neon pink glows.
AI recommendation cards ('Buy now', 'Wait 3 days', 'Price increasing alert'). Clean white cards with sharp contrasting text and subtle drop shadows.
Weekly roster grid. AI suggestions highlighted in Purple (#8b5cf6) indicating optimized scheduling to reduce labor costs.
Map-based UI. Use a CSS dotted grid with glowing pulse points representing restaurant locations. Sidebar showing consolidated cross-location metrics.
Executive dashboard. KPI cards with Recharts or CSS-based bar/line charts. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers. Strict alignment.
Use react-fast-marquee. Ecosystem badges via react-icons/si (Stripe, Twilio, UberEats, QuickBooks, etc). Low contrast grayscale logos that light up on hover.
NUA vs Traditional POS. Use high contrast borders, checkmarks in Purple/Orange, X marks in muted gray. Rows for 'AI Automation', 'Unified Data', 'Setup Time'.
Highlight 'AI Agent included' in all tiers. Middle card elevated with Purple border and subtle glow.

sections.content: H2: 'Stop Running Systems. Start Running Intelligence.'
sections.visuals: Ambient glow (Purple + Orange) behind text. Dual CTAs matching hero. Use the provided abstract background texture.

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Add custom brand colors. Primary CTA: bg-[#f58c14] text-white hover:bg-[#d87b10]. Secondary CTA: border-[#8b5cf6] text-[#8b5cf6] hover:bg-[#8b5cf6]/10.
components.cards: Remove default shadcn borders for dark mode, use border-white/5. For light mode, use clean solid white with shadow-sm.
components.badges: Rounded-full, text-xs, font-mono. E.g., bg-[#8b5cf6]/10 text-[#8b5cf6].

images_to_use.description: Dark abstract texture with shimmering highlights. Use as a low-opacity background overlay in the Final CTA or Hero section.

media.icons: Use react-icons/si for specific brand logos (SiStripe, SiTwilio). Use lucide-react for all general UI icons (Chart, Users, Map, Mic).
media.mockups: CRITICAL: Do not use stock images of restaurants or real POS screenshots. Construct all UI elements, charts, and dashboard snippets using raw HTML/Tailwind CSS and Shadcn primitives to maintain the high-end Stripe/Linear SaaS aesthetic.

testing.requirements: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive and key informational elements. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='hero-book-demo-btn', data-testid='pricing-starter-card', data-testid='module-pos-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,600;12..96,800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');
Update tailwind.config.js to include font families: sans: ['Manrope', 'sans-serif'], display: ['Bricolage Grotesque', 'sans-serif'], mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'monospace'].
Use framer-motion heavily but subtly. Rely on scroll-triggered fade-ins and scale-ups.
All components must be written in .js files, NOT .tsx. Strip typescript types from any shadcn code.
Construct the dashboard hero visual purely out of CSS grids, absolutely positioned glassy cards, and lucide-react icons.
Alternate background sections exactly as specified (Dark -> Light -> Dark) to match the nomni.ai pacing constraint.
Ensure the sticky header has z-50 and a backdrop blur, avoiding content overlap.
Never use raw 'inter' font anywhere. Enforce the provided typography strategy.
